programs.name: SenioRx prescription help
programs.desc: Free or low-cost 3-month supplies of prescription drugs through manufacturer programs.
programs.who: 55+ with a chronic condition and no drug coverage, any age with a disability, or Medicare in the coverage gap

programs.name: Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI)
programs.desc: Monthly benefits for people who can't work because of a disability and have enough work credits.
programs.who: Workers with a qualifying disability and enough work history

programs.name: Supplemental Security Income (SSI)
programs.desc: Monthly cash for people with very low income and few resources who are 65+, blind, or disabled.
programs.who: Age 65+, blind or disabled, with limited income and resources

programs.name: VA benefits
programs.desc: Disability compensation, pension, Aid & Attendance and other benefits for veterans and survivors.
programs.who: Veterans, dependents and survivors

programs.name: VA health care
programs.desc: Health care enrollment for eligible veterans.
programs.who: Veterans meeting service and discharge requirements

programs.name: Veterans Crisis Line
programs.desc: 24/7 confidential crisis support. Dial 988 then press 1, or text 838255.
programs.who: Veterans, service members and families

programs.name: Veterans Service Officers
programs.desc: Free help filing VA claims, appeals, Aid & Attendance and survivor benefits through county offices.
programs.who: Veterans, dependents and survivors

programs.name: Volunteer Lawyers Program
programs.desc: Free civil legal help from volunteer attorneys. Jefferson County residents use Volunteer Lawyers Birmingham: 205-250-5198.
programs.who: Low-income residents
